source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#9
english_title: Example 2.1.4: The Logarithmic Sequence Modulo 1 Is Dense
statement_en: The sequence of fractional parts $\{\log n\}$ is dense in $[0,1)$, because $\log n\to +\infty$ and $\log(n+1)-\log n=\log(1+\frac{1}{n})\to 0$.
callout_body: 对数序列模1形成的序列$\{\log(n)\}$在$[0,1)$当中稠密，因为$\log(n)\to +\infty$并且$\log(n+1)-\log(n)=\log(1+\frac{1}{n})\to 0$。
